units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 3. Within the powers transferred under the agreement, the organizer of a joint tender or auction shall be subject to the provisions of this Federal Law governing the rights and obligations of a contracting authority and procurement control, monitoring and audit. The organizer shall:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 1) establish a procurement commission;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 2) publish in the unified information system the information and documents necessary for selecting a supplier (contractor, service provider);
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 3) submit, in accordance with this Federal Law, the request for approval of a closed tender or closed auction provided for by part 2 of Article 72 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 4) send invitations to participate in the joint closed tender or closed auction and prepare the documents required by this Federal Law for a closed tender or closed auction;
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 5) approve and provide procurement documentation, where this Federal Law provides for such documentation, and clarify the provisions of the procurement notice and procurement documentation, where such documentation is provided for;
units.label: Point 5 Part 3 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Joint tenders and auctions
units.text: 6) exercise other powers provided for by the agreement.
units.label: Point 6 Part 3 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 26. Centralized procurement
units.text: Article 26. Centralized procurement
units.label: Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Centralized procurement
units.text: 1. For centralized procurement under legislation of the Russian Federation, legislation of its constituent entities and municipal legal acts, except in the cases provided for by parts 2 and 3 of this Article, one or more state bodies, municipal bodies or treasury institutions authorized to select suppliers (contractors, service providers) for contracting authorities may be established, or those powers may be assigned to one or more existing such bodies or institutions. Those authorized bodies or institutions shall select suppliers (contractors, service providers) for contracting authorities within the powers established by the decisions creating them or assigning those powers. They may not be assigned powers to justify procurement, determine contract terms, including the initial (maximum) contract price, or sign contracts. Contracts shall be signed by the contracting authorities for which the suppliers (contractors, service providers) have been selected.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Centralized procurement
units.text: 2. The President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation may assign to one or more federal executive bodies or federal treasury institutions the powers to select suppliers (contractors, service providers) for several federal executive bodies, federal treasury or budget-funded institutions and federal state unitary enterprises, and also powers to plan procurement, select suppliers (contractors, service providers), conclude and perform contracts, including acceptance of goods supplied, works performed (their results) and services provided, and arrangement of payment, for several such bodies, institutions or enterprises.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Centralized procurement
units.text: 3. The highest executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or a local administration may assign powers to select suppliers (contractors, service providers) for several executive bodies, treasury or budget-funded institutions and state unitary enterprises of that constituent entity, or municipal bodies, municipal treasury or budget-funded institutions and municipal unitary enterprises; and also powers to plan procurement, select suppliers (contractors, service providers), conclude and perform contracts, including acceptance of goods supplied, works performed (their results) and services provided and arrangement of payment, for several executive bodies, treasury or budget-funded institutions and state unitary enterprises of the constituent entity, local self-government bodies, municipal treasury or budget-funded institutions and municipal unitary enterprises. Those powers may be assigned, respectively, to one or more executive bodies or treasury institutions of the constituent entity or municipal bodies or municipal treasury institutions.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Centralized procurement
units.text: 4. Authorized bodies or institutions vested with powers to select suppliers (contractors, service providers) to meet the needs of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation may exercise the corresponding powers of authorized bodies or institutions of municipal entities under agreements between that constituent entity and municipal entities within its territory.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Centralized procurement
units.text: 5. A federal executive body, executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or local self-government body must decide how contracting authority powers will be exercised by that body, its territorial bodies or institutions for which it performs the functions and powers of founder, using the following methods:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Centralized procurement
units.text: 1) exercise by those bodies of powers to:
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Centralized procurement
units.text: а) select suppliers (contractors, service providers) for the relevant contracting authorities;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 5 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Centralized procurement
units.text: б) plan and conduct procurement, including selection of suppliers (contractors, service providers), conclusion and performance of state or municipal contracts, with the possibility of accepting goods supplied, works performed (their results) and services provided, for the relevant state or municipal contracting authorities;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 5 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Centralized procurement
units.text: 2) vesting one or more authorized bodies or institutions with powers to select suppliers (contractors, service providers) for the relevant contracting authorities;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Centralized procurement
units.text: 3) vesting one or more authorized bodies or institutions with powers to plan and conduct procurement, including selection of suppliers (contractors, service providers), conclusion and performance of state or municipal contracts, with the possibility of accepting goods supplied, works performed (their results) and services provided, for the relevant state and municipal contracting authorities;
units.label: Point 3 Part 5 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Centralized procurement
units.text: 4) independent exercise by each contracting authority of its own powers.
units.label: Point 4 Part 5 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Centralized procurement
units.text: 6. Where a condition for earmarked interbudgetary transfers from the federal budget or budgets of state extrabudgetary funds of the Russian Federation is centralization of procurement funded wholly or partly by those transfers, the Government of the Russian Federation may empower an authorized body or institution to select suppliers (contractors, service providers) for state contracting authorities acting on behalf of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, municipal contracting authorities, the relevant budget-funded institutions, state or municipal unitary enterprises and/or authorized bodies or institutions whose powers are determined by decisions of state authorities of the constituent entity or local self-government bodies.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Centralized procurement
units.text: 7. Where a condition for earmarked interbudgetary transfers from the budget of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation is centralization of procurement funded wholly or partly by those transfers, the highest executive body of that constituent entity may empower an authorized body or institution to select suppliers (contractors, service providers) for municipal contracting authorities, municipal budget-funded institutions, state or municipal unitary enterprises and/or authorized bodies or institutions acting on behalf of the constituent entity, municipal contracting authorities, the relevant budget-funded institutions, state or municipal unitary enterprises and/or authorized bodies or institutions whose powers are determined by decisions of local self-government bodies.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Centralized procurement
units.text: 8. An authorized body or institution of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, or an authorized municipal institution of a municipal entity, exercising powers to select suppliers (contractors, service providers) under an agreement between the constituent entity and the municipal entity, may exercise the corresponding powers of authorized bodies or institutions of that constituent entity or municipal entity for state contracting authorities acting on behalf of the constituent entity, its budget-funded institutions and state unitary enterprises, municipal contracting authorities, municipal budget-funded institutions and municipal unitary enterprises.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Centralized procurement
units.text: 9. Authorized bodies or institutions whose powers are determined by decisions of local self-government bodies of a municipal district, municipal okrug or urban okrug may select suppliers (contractors, service providers) for individual municipal contracting authorities acting on behalf of settlements, budget-funded institutions and municipal unitary enterprises of settlements, and/or authorized bodies or institutions whose powers are determined by the decisions of settlement local self-government bodies referred to in parts 3 and 5 of this Article, under agreements between the municipal district, municipal okrug or urban okrug and the settlements forming part of it.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Centralized procurement
units.text: 10. The procedure for interaction between contracting authorities and authorized bodies or institutions shall be determined by decisions establishing those bodies or institutions or assigning powers to them under this Article.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Centralized procurement
units.text: 11. Activities of authorized bodies or institutions within the powers established by decisions creating them or assigning powers under this Article shall be subject to the provisions of this Federal Law governing contracting authorities’ rights and obligations and procurement control, monitoring and audit.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 27. Participation in the selection of suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: Article 27. Participation in the selection of suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.label: Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Participation in the selection of suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 1. Participation in the selection of suppliers (contractors, service providers) may be restricted only in the cases provided for by this Federal Law. Rejection of an application to participate in procurement on grounds not provided for by this Federal Law is prohibited.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Participation in the selection of suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 2. Where a contracting authority decides to restrict participation in the selection of a supplier (contractor, service provider), the procurement notice must state the restriction and explain its reasons.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Participation in the selection of suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 3. Procurement participants may act in procurement-related relations either directly or through representatives. Representatives’ powers shall be confirmed by a power of attorney issued and drawn up under civil legislation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Participation in the selection of suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 4. Preferences under Articles 28–30 of this Federal Law shall be granted in procurement to:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Participation in the selection of suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 1) institutions and enterprises of the penal enforcement system;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Participation in the selection of suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 2) organizations of persons with disabilities;
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Participation in the selection of suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 3) small enterprises;
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Participation in the selection of suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 4) socially oriented non-profit organizations.
units.label: Point 4 Part 4 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Participation in the selection of suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 5. Charging for accreditation on an electronic platform or specialized electronic platform, or for participation in the selection of suppliers (contractors, service providers), is prohibited except in the cases provided for by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Participation in the selection of suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 6. For procurement of industrial products subject to measures adopted by the Government of the Russian Federation under point 1 of part 2 of Article 14 of this Federal Law, the Government may establish cases where an application offering goods of Russian origin is treated as an application offering goods originating in a foreign state, if another application has been submitted and, following examination, found to meet the requirements of the procurement notice and procurement documentation, where such documentation is provided for by this Federal Law, and offers goods of Russian origin that satisfy to the greatest extent the requirements imposed on industrial products under industrial policy legislation for classification as Russian industrial products.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 28. Participation of institutions and enterprises of the penal enforcement system in procurement
units.text: Article 28. Participation of institutions and enterprises of the penal enforcement system in procurement
units.label: Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Participation of institutions and enterprises of the penal enforcement system in procurement
units.text: 1. Where a contract is concluded following competitive methods with a participant that is an institution or enterprise of the penal enforcement system, the contract price and each unit price of goods, works or services in the case provided for by part 24 of Article 22 of this Federal Law shall be increased by fifteen percent over, respectively, that participant’s proposed contract price or the unit price determined under this Federal Law on the basis of its offer for the total of unit prices. The resulting increased prices may not exceed the initial (maximum) contract price or initial unit prices.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Participation of institutions and enterprises of the penal enforcement system in procurement
units.text: 2. The Government of the Russian Federation shall approve the list of goods, works and services whose procurement qualifies for preferences under this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Participation of institutions and enterprises of the penal enforcement system in procurement
units.text: 3. The procurement subject matter may not include goods, works or services other than those on the list provided for by part 2 of this Article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 29. Participation of organizations of persons with disabilities in procurement
units.text: Article 29. Participation of organizations of persons with disabilities in procurement
units.label: Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Participation of organizations of persons with disabilities in procurement
units.text: 1. Where a contract is concluded following competitive methods with a participant that is an organization of persons with disabilities, the contract price and each unit price of goods, works or services in the case provided for by part 24 of Article 22 of this Federal Law shall be increased by fifteen percent over, respectively, that participant’s proposed contract price or the unit price determined under this Federal Law on the basis of its offer for the total of unit prices. The resulting increased prices may not exceed the initial (maximum) contract price or initial unit prices.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Participation of organizations of persons with disabilities in procurement
units.text: 2. This Article applies to all-Russian public organizations of persons with disabilities, including those formed as unions of such organizations, in which persons with disabilities and their legal representatives constitute at least eighty percent of members; and to organizations whose charter (pooled) capital consists entirely of contributions from all-Russian public organizations of persons with disabilities, in which the average number of employees with disabilities relative to other employees is at least fifty percent, and their share of the wage fund is at least twenty-five percent.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Participation of organizations of persons with disabilities in procurement
units.text: 3. The Government of the Russian Federation shall approve the list of goods, works and services whose procurement qualifies for preferences under this Article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Participation of organizations of persons with disabilities in procurement
units.text: 4. The procurement subject matter may not include goods, works or services other than those on the list provided for by part 3 of this Article.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 30. Participation of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations in procurement
units.text: Article 30. Participation of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations in procurement
units.label: Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Participation of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations in procurement
units.text: 1. Contracting authorities must procure from small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations an amount of at least twenty-five percent of the aggregate annual procurement volume calculated taking account of part 1.1 of this Article, by:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Participation of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations in procurement
units.text: 1) conducting open competitive methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers) in which only small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations may participate. The initial (maximum) contract price must not exceed twenty million rubles;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Participation of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations in procurement
units.text: 2) conducting procurement subject to part 5 of this Article.
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Participation of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations in procurement
units.text: 1.1. In determining the procurement volume provided for by part 1 of this Article, the following procurement shall be excluded from the aggregate annual procurement volume:
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Participation of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations in procurement
units.text: 1) procurement for national defence and state security;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1.1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Participation of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations in procurement
units.text: 2) procurement of loan provision services;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1.1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Participation of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations in procurement
units.text: 3) procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) under part 1 of Article 93 of this Federal Law, legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system, except procurement under point 25 of part 1 of Article 93 of this Federal Law following an unsuccessful selection of a supplier (contractor, service provider) conducted under point 1 of part 1 of this Article;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1.1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Participation of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations in procurement
units.text: 4) procurement of works in the use of atomic energy;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1.1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Participation of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations in procurement
units.text: 5) procurement using closed methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers);
units.label: Point 5 Part 1.1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Participation of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations in procurement
units.text: 6) procurement in cases established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 6 Part 1.1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Participation of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations in procurement
units.text: 1.2. Contracting authorities may procure the items specified in points 1, 4 and 5 of part 1.1 of this Article from small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations under part 1 of this Article. The amount of such procurement shall count towards procurement from those entities under part 1 of this Article and shall be included in the report specified in part 4 of this Article.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Participation of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations in procurement
units.text: 2. This Article applies to socially oriented non-profit organizations, except those founded by the Russian Federation, its constituent entities or municipal entities, that carry out, in accordance with their founding documents, the activities provided for by point 1 of Article 31.1 of Federal Law of 12 January 1996 No. 7-FZ “On Non-Profit Organizations”.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Participation of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations in procurement
units.text: 3. When suppliers (contractors, service providers) are selected using the methods specified in point 1 of part 1 of this Article, procurement notices shall establish a preference for participants, which may be only small enterprises or socially oriented non-profit organizations.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Participation of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations in procurement
units.text: 4. Where selection of a supplier (contractor, service provider) is declared unsuccessful because no applications were submitted by the deadline or all applications were rejected under this Federal Law, the contracting authority may cancel the preference specified in part 3 of this Article and conduct procurement on general terms. Such procurement on general terms shall not count towards procurement from small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations under part 1 of this Article. Procurement under point 25 of part 1 of Article 93 of this Federal Law following an unsuccessful selection conducted in accordance with point 1 of part 1 of this Article shall count towards procurement from those entities. Following the end of the year, the contracting authority, except one included in the list provided for by point 5 of part 11 of Article 24 of this Federal Law, must prepare a report on procurement from small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations specified in part 2 of this Article and publish it in the unified information system before 1 April of the following year. The report shall include information on contracts concluded with those entities.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Participation of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations in procurement
units.text: 4.1. The Government of the Russian Federation shall determine the procedure for preparing and publishing the report specified in part 4 of this Article in the unified information system, and its form.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Participation of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations in procurement
units.text: 5. When selecting a supplier (contractor, service provider), a contracting authority may require in the procurement notice that a supplier (contractor, service provider) that is not a small enterprise or socially oriented non-profit organization engage subcontractors or co-performers from those categories to perform the contract.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Participation of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations in procurement
units.text: 6. In the case provided for by part 5 of this Article, the condition requiring subcontractors or co-performers that are small enterprises or socially oriented non-profit organizations shall be included in the contract, specifying their participation as a percentage of the contract price. That amount shall count towards procurement from those entities under part 1 of this Article and be included in the report specified in part 4 of this Article. The contract must also include a mandatory clause on the supplier’s (contractor’s, service provider’s) civil liability for failure to meet the condition requiring those subcontractors or co-performers.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Participation of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organizations in procurement
units.text: 7. The Government of the Russian Federation may establish standard terms for contracts providing for the engagement of subcontractors or co-performers that are small enterprises or socially oriented non-profit organizations.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 30
